highlights: A notable trend sees the release of highly efficient and specialized AI models, including compact vision-language models for on-device deployment and small, open-source tool-calling models, significantly broadening the scope for accessible AI applications.

Leading companies like Google and OpenAI are intensifying their focus on advanced agent capabilities and cybersecurity, launching new model iterations, high-performance API tiers, and dedicated cyber defense models to meet growing enterprise demands.

The developer ecosystem is being enriched with new open-source agent frameworks and comprehensive guides for fine-tuning LLMs, empowering builders to create sophisticated, secure, and reasoning-focused AI agents and specialized models.

agents.title: DeepSeek AI Releases DeepSeek Harness: An MIT-Licensed Agent Harness
agents.summary: DeepSeek Harness is an MIT-licensed, plugin-based agent framework offering flexible runtime modes and provider-agnostic model routing, accelerating the development of robust AI agents. This developer preview provides a foundational platform where every capability integrates as a Cordis plugin.

agents.title: Agentao: A Governed Local-First Runtime for Tool-Using LLM Agents
agents.summary: Agentao introduces a governed local-first runtime for tool-using LLM agents, explicitly separating model-generated actions from host-authorized execution through permissions. This open-source system enhances auditability, security, and inspectability for agents operating in host-controlled local environments.

agents.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, Hooks, and More
agents.summary: Google expands Gemini API's Managed Agents with new capabilities like Gemini 3.6 Flash support and hooks, enabling developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents. These enhancements streamline the creation of sophisticated agents for diverse applications.

models.title: Google AI Releases Gemini 3.7 Flash: Coding and Agent Model
models.summary: Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash, an algorithmic refinement of 3.6 Flash, offers enhanced coding and agent capabilities across multimodal inputs with a 1M-token context. Available via API at a competitive $0.75/1M input tokens, it significantly boosts performance in coding and workflow automation tasks.

models.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-VL-3B: On-Device Vision-Language Model
models.summary: Liquid AI introduces LFM2.5-VL-3B, a compact 3.1B-parameter vision-language model designed for efficient on-device deployment. It excels in screen reading, object grounding, and function calling, consuming minimal RAM and achieving high token decoding speeds on edge hardware.

models.title: Meta Releases Muse Glimmer: Local, Agentic, Multimodal, Open Source
models.summary: Meta launches Muse Glimmer, a new open-source model that is local, agentic, and multimodal, empowering on-device AI applications and community-driven innovation. This release provides robust capabilities for developers building intelligent systems at the edge.

tools.title: OpenAI Previews Ultrafast Mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at 14X Speed
tools.summary: OpenAI introduces Ultrafast mode, a new API service tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14 times faster, delivering up to 750 output tokens per second, powered by Cerebras. This significant speed boost enables developers to achieve unprecedented throughput for their high-demand AI applications.

tools.title: Google Sheets Canvas: Bring Spreadsheet Data to Life with AI
tools.summary: Google Sheets introduces 'Sheets canvas,' a new AI-powered feature enabling users to transform raw spreadsheet data into interactive dashboards, custom trackers, and more using simple natural language prompts. This tool significantly enhances data visualization and productivity within Google Workspace.

tools.title: Hugging Face Integrates Strands Agents & LeRobot for Robotics MLOps
tools.summary: Hugging Face now integrates Strands Agents and LeRobot with Storage Buckets, providing a streamlined, end-to-end platform for recording, training, and deploying robot-manipulation data and models. This unified workflow empowers developers to efficiently manage their robotics AI development lifecycle.

companies.title: OpenAI Expands Daybreak Cyber Defense with GPT-5.6-Cyber
companies.summary: OpenAI expands its Daybreak initiative, launching GPT-5.6-Cyber for authorized cybersecurity applications and making these frontier models available to approved partners via AWS Bedrock. This strategic move strengthens enterprise defenses against evolving cyber threats.

companies.title: OpenAI Begins Testing Ads in ChatGPT
companies.summary: OpenAI commences testing advertisements within ChatGPT to support continued free access, committing to clear labeling, robust privacy protections, and user control. This initiative aims to explore monetization strategies while maintaining the user experience and answer independence.

companies.title: Google AI Introduces New AI Tools for Marketing Evolution
companies.summary: Google introduces new AI and agentic experiences across Google Ads and Google Analytics, designed to simplify marketing workflows and enhance efficiency for businesses. These updates aim to empower marketing professionals with more intelligent tools for campaign optimization and insights.

learning.title: Guide: Fine-Tuning Tool-Calling LLMs with XYZ-Aquila-SFT and Qwen3
learning.summary: This comprehensive tutorial provides a complete guide for implementing an end-to-end fine-tuning pipeline for tool-calling language models. It covers crucial steps from parsing trajectories and structured tool-call extraction to efficient LoRA adaptation using PyTorch.

learning.title: The Builder’s Guide to GPT-5.6 by OpenAI
learning.summary: OpenAI's new guide for builders teaches startups how to leverage GPT-5.6 to create faster, more cost-efficient AI agents. It focuses on smart model selection and new Responses API capabilities, empowering developers to optimize their agentic AI solutions.

learning.title: Guide: Create a Reasoning-Focused LLM with SupraLabs Corpus
learning.summary: This practical guide offers a complete workflow for building compact, reasoning-focused language models by streaming, curating, and fine-tuning the SupraLabs reasoning corpus from Hugging Face. It demonstrates an end-to-end pipeline for developing specialized small models efficiently.
